name: Kamioosaki Suguru
source:
Type: human
Skills: exorcising ayakashi, healing
Occupation: onmyoji, running a company, etc.
Location: Harajuku

[i]"You really like rice, don't you? That's great and all, but you should also be keeping up on fish and meat..."[/i]

A young man who works as an onmyoji and makes regular appearances on television and in magazines due to his popularity. 

He attended the same junior high and high school as Tengenjibashi, and while he is not as skilled in the art of sealing and destroying ayakashi as his old friend, he does possess the ability to heal.

He has a tendency to mother others, often fussing over Tengenjibashi―sometimes even scolding him, but he does so for his sake. He makes sure to keep up appearances while on the job as a manager but is an honest and devoted man with a cheerful disposition at heart.

[Edited from [url=https://twitter.com/i/events/1495144875670573056]Moonchime Localization[/url]]
translation:
类型：人类
技能：驱除妖怪、治疗
职业：阴阳师、经营公司等
地点：原宿

[i]“你真的很喜欢米饭啊？这很好，但也要注意吃鱼和肉……”[/i]

一名作为阴阳师工作的人气青年，经常登上电视和杂志。

他与天元寺桥就读同一所初中和高中。虽然在封印、消灭妖怪方面不如老友，却拥有治疗能力。

他很爱照顾别人，经常对天元寺桥嘘寒问暖，有时甚至训斥他，但一切都是为了对方着想。作为经理工作时，他会注意维持体面；本质上却是个诚实专一、性格开朗的人。

[根据[url=https://twitter.com/i/events/1495144875670573056]Moonchime Localization[/url]编辑。]
